exact_statement: For any finite original conditioned queue with positive feasible packing lambda, activities x_e=lambda_e*pi_e, A0=sum x_e and D=prod(1+x_e)-1, mark a fixed set G of gate names of total lambda weight t. If z>=1, zt<=1/16 and zA0<=1/16, then E[1_finite_success z^(R-1+M_G)]<=16/19, where R is the initial root count and M_G counts marked CHILD visits with repetitions. Consequently, for every integer w>=32, r=2^w, U=AND of r disjoint width-w OR clauses, V(Y)=1-U(-Y) on an independent clone, and F=2U(X)V(Y)-1, every pair of original complete positive/negative-prime queues with independently arbitrary positive packing-feasible weights and arbitrary ordered covers satisfies C_mix(F)/I(F)>w/2592 for EVERY fixed normalized output mixture alpha Q_+ +(1-alpha)Q_-, alpha in [0,1]. This lower bound includes all finite runs, repeated gates, overlapping subsets and output ambiguity. Meanwhile H(F)<8I(F), so this is an obstruction to this fixed-pair coding route, not an FEI counterexample. Each original root normalizer is retained separately.

exact_statement: For every integer w>=64, let r=2^w, U be the AND of r disjoint width-w OR clauses and F=2U(X)[1-U(-Y)]-1 on independent uniform blocks. Every fixed normalized output mixture of at most floor(2^(w/4)) original complete positive-prime queues of F and any finite or countable collection of original complete negative-prime queues has complete nonempty Fourier-weighted cross entropy C_mix(F)/I(F)>w/2592, uniformly over all independently chosen positive packing-feasible vectors, all valid ordered covers, all fixed mixture priors, and all posteriors over reference names and actual runs. Hence the variational infimum over this bounded representation class diverges, although H(F)<8I(F). More generally, with L>=1 positive references and Z=2^w/(48Lw)>=1, put B=min{(ceil(w/2)-1)log2 Z,2^w-1}; if B>0 then C_mix(F)/I(F)>B/(324w).

All weights and mixture priors fixed before sampling a Fourier set; failed and infinite runs provide no output; full finite successful mass includes repeated gates and overlapping subsets.
The all-size budget theorem uses w>=64; the tradeoff uses the same Boolean family and its stated Z and B conditions.
Cost and entropy are bits. This excludes unrestricted positive-reference mixtures, nonprime dictionaries and new once-per-set shared-tag codes; no FEI disproof is claimed.
